crazing.definition: Fine network of cracks on the steel surface.
crazing.cause: Thermal stress during rapid cooling or rolling.
crazing.action: Inspect cooling spray nozzles and verify rolling temperature.

inclusion.definition: Non-metallic particles embedded in the steel.
inclusion.cause: Slag or refractory material entering the molten steel.
inclusion.action: Review ladle cleanliness and tundish practices.

rolled_pit.definition: Small, localized depressions on the surface.
rolled_pit.action: Check descaling system pressure and roll condition.

waist_folding.definition: Severe folding or overlapping of the steel edge.
waist_folding.cause: Improper width reduction during hot rolling.
waist_folding.action: Adjust edger roll gap and inspect side guides.

patches.definition: Irregular, patch-like areas of discoloration or roughness on the steel surface.
patches.cause: Uneven cooling, oxidation, or localized scale buildup during the rolling process.
patches.action: Inspect the descaling nozzles and verify the cooling bed spray uniformity.

pitted_surface.definition: Small, shallow craters or pits scattered across the surface.
pitted_surface.cause: Gas evolution during solidification or localized corrosion.
pitted_surface.action: Review the continuous casting parameters and check for moisture in the mold flux.

scratches.definition: Linear grooves or abrasions on the steel surface.
scratches.cause: Mechanical friction from guide rolls, conveyors, or handling equipment.
scratches.action: Inspect the roll surfaces and check the tension on the conveyor belts.
